init.description:
**ANMA · Your energy at a glance**

{summary}

---

Open a field and type part of a name or entity ID, e.g. bat. Results show the name, value, unit and entity ID. Values were read at {updated}; an open list does not update automatically. Select “Refresh values” below and submit for a new snapshot. Your selections remain in the draft. “Not mapped” clears that mapping.

data_description.invert_battery_power: ANMA: positive means charging; negative means discharging. Check the result on the next screen.
data_description.invert_grid_power: ANMA: positive means import; negative means export.

review.title: Review before saving

pairing.title: ANMA · Website connection
pairing.description: Save your source mappings first. The code grants read-only access to ANMA metrics over Tailscale. A new code replaces the previous one; redeeming it replaces the website connection credential.

generate_code.title: ANMA · Pairing code
generate_code.description:
## `{code}`

Valid for 15 minutes, until HA restarts, or until redeemed. Give it to the owner. Enter the home name, this machine’s Tailscale IP and code on the website. Keep it private. Submit to return.

revoke.title: Revoke access?
revoke.description: Confirm to stop the website reading data. HA entities remain. Re-pairing will be required to restore access.
